frozenHelp: Price and probabilities frozen when chosen: they do not change afterwards.

evaluation.title: Evaluation mode
evaluation.body: Evaluation records, built from picks of models that have not yet beaten the market. Only the administrator sees them; they are not a recommendation.

daily.title: Picks of the day
daily.subtitle: Chosen by PrediGol for {date}: they stay after kick-off and are settled when the match ends.
daily.partial_one: Only {count} selection met the criteria today. We never pad the list.
daily.partial_other: Only {count} selections met the criteria today. We never pad the list.
daily.emptyBody: We only choose selections from models that have beaten the market, without the bookmakers' margin, in their own backtest. A day without any stays empty.

reason.no_shadow_picks: No evaluation records for this day

parlay.pAllLowHelp: Product of each selection's cautious probability: the low end of the model's interval.

building.title: Looking for the parlay
building.body: There are selections with value, but no combination grows at their cautious probability. We never pad a parlay.

none.title: No parlay yet
none.body: It is built when there are selections with value in its window.

void.title: There was no parlay this day
void.body: No combination met the criteria before the day ended.

actions.choose: What would you like to do with this price?
actions.quarterLine: Quarter lines (.25 / .75) cannot go in a parlay

toast.replaced: We changed that match's selection: one per match
toast.full: A parlay takes at most {max} selections

slip.title: My parlay
slip.subtitle: One selection per match, {min} to {max}.
slip.emptyBody: Tap a price on a match, or “Add to parlay” on a pick.
slip.name: Name (optional)
slip.noCombined: No combined odds: a selection has no price
slip.note: Each selection's price is the best current price we know; it is saved with the parlay.

error.leg_count: A parlay needs between {min} and {max} selections.
error.invalid_selection: Selection {leg}: not a selection we settle.
error.quarter_line: Selection {leg}: quarter lines (.25 / .75) are not allowed in a parlay.
error.unknown_fixture: Selection {leg}: that match does not exist.
error.same_fixture: Selections {with} and {leg}: they are the same match.

warning.shared_team: Selections {with} and {leg} share a team: their results are related.
warning.no_price: Selection {leg}: we have no current price.

mine.title: My picks
mine.subtitle: What you saved and how it went, next to what PrediGol chose.

results.title: My results
results.note: By the day the match kicks off in your time zone ({zone}). Profit in units of one stake, at the recorded price. PrediGol handles no money and takes no bets.

picks.title: Saved picks
picks.empty: You have not saved a pick yet
picks.emptyBody: Tap a price on a match, or “Save” on a PrediGol pick.
picks.oddsLabel: Price you got at your bookmaker
picks.settlesAt: Settled at your price if you give one; otherwise at the price shown.

parlays.title: My parlays
parlays.empty: You have not built a parlay yet
parlays.emptyBody: Add selections to your parlay from matches or picks.
